For a security vulnerability, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting publicly.
Do not attach credentials, raw production logs or private corpora.

### Affected skill and version

Include the commit or package/plugin version, OS and Python version.

### Reproduction

Provide the command and a minimal synthetic or deliberately redacted fixture.

### Expected and actual result

Include exit status and sanitized output. Explain any missing or stale evidence.
